ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee (credit $4.50 to driver); no refund to rider; no account flag needed on this record.

rejected_claims.reason: Rider asserted she came out a minute after cancellation. The driver had already pressed 'I'm Here' at 17:18:50, remained within ~50 m of the pickup and stationary for ~4 minutes, and the cancellation at 17:22:30 came after the 3-minute wait expired. NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii) are all satisfied, so the $6.61 fee stands; no refund.
